svg.title: Compensation: a salary history, not a column — SoftTrack web design mockup (#131)
svg.desc: Finance → Compensation lists each person’s current agreed pay, the latest record whose effective date has passed, with subtotals per currency and schedule. Each person has an append-only history: raises and corrections are new rows.
svg.text: Compensation: a salary history, not a column
· append-only, effective-dated, in the currency it was agreed in
signed in as Grace, a finance admin

g.text: Gross agreed pay per person, as a history. The current figure is the latest record
that has taken effect. Finance admins only.

svg.text: A compensation table: user, amount (integer minor units), currency, pay schedule, effective date, note, recorded by. Append-only. Read and write are finance-admin only, on
dedicated endpoints with dedicated schemas. No deductions, withholding, bonus or equity: gross agreed pay is the record.
